command:
set -eu
imap_host=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node1" {print $1}')
[ -n "$imap_host" ]
IMAP_HOST="$imap_host" python3 - <<'PY'
import email
import imaplib
import os
import re
import ssl

host = os.environ["IMAP_HOST"]
password = [REDACTED]]
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
client = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host, 993, ssl_context=ctx)
typ, _ = client.login("archive", password)
print("AUTHENTICATION:", typ)
typ, data = client.select("INBOX", readonly=True)
print("SELECT:", typ, "EXISTS:", data[0].decode())
typ, data = client.search(None, "ALL")
message_numbers = data[0].split()
print("SEARCH:", typ, "MESSAGES:", len(message_numbers))
for number in message_numbers:
    typ, parts = client.fetch(number, "(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])")
    meta, raw = parts[0]
    flags = re.search(rb"FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)", meta).group(1).decode()
    msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
    body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode().strip()
    print("MESSAGE", number.decode(), "FLAGS:", "(" + flags + ")")
    print("MESSAGE-ID:", msg["Message-ID"])
